t: Uses a single blade to cut mild steel, non-ferrous metals, plastic and wood, even if nails are embedded in the material. Provides clean and precise cuts no matter the material. Bevels to 45° in both directions and offers a maximum cross cut of 300 x 80mm both ways. Integrated laser cutting guide and positive bevel stops provide accuracy with every cut. Durable die-cast aluminium base supports a variety of materials. Features powerful 2000W motor and ergonomic over-moulded, in-line handle. On-board tool storage for convenient storage of the blade change hex key.
